subtitle: Under the same cold stars, numbers and light share one sky

panels.shot: wide night vista from a cliff, monastery silhouetted below a blaze of stars, a distant modern dome glinting faintly on another ridge
panels.action: Hanle rTsis-pa Monk stands on a wind-swept ledge above the monastery, prayer beads in one hand, a worn wooden calculating board in the other, gazing up at the icy, crystal sky where the Milky Way arcs over a faint observatory dome.

dialogue.text: On the high plateau of Hanle, monks once counted moons by hand; four centuries later, steel domes count photons from the same cold sky.

i18n.hi: हनले के ऊँचे पठार पर भिक्षु कभी हाथों से चाँद गिनते थे; चार सौ साल बाद, इस्पाती गुम्बद उसी ठंडे आकाश से फोटॉन गिनते हैं।

panels.shot: aerial establishing shot over the Changthang plateau, sweeping toward Hanle valley at dawn
panels.action: The camera glides above the barren, ochre and grey expanse of the Changthang plateau, thin river threads and frozen pools glinting, as a small cluster of whitewashed buildings clings to a rocky spur in the vast emptiness.

dialogue.text: East of Leh, beyond the great passes, the Changthang opens like a stone sea, thin air, hard light and a silence that remembers only hooves and wind.

i18n.hi: लेह के पूरब, बड़े दर्रों के पार, चांगथांग पत्थर के सागर-सा खुलता है: पतली हवा, कड़ी धूप, और खामोशी जिसमें बस खुरों की धमक और हवा की याद है।

panels.shot: historical flashback, mid-wide view of Sengge Namgyal’s imagined court receiving a Drukpa lama, with a monk in the background
panels.action: Inside a Ladakhi hall hung with simple banners, Sengge Namgyal sits in fur-lined robes on a low dais as a crimson-robed Drukpa lama gestures on a rough map toward Hanle; in the background, a young monk watches wide-eyed, clutching a palm-leaf manuscript.

dialogue.text: The La dvags rgyal rabs recalls: under Sengge Namgyal, Ladakh’s Lion King, a Drukpa monastery rose at Hanle, binding this lonely valley into a wider sacred geography.

i18n.hi: ला-द्वाक्स ग्याल रब्स बताता है: सेंगे नामग्याल, लद्दाख के सिंह-राजा के समय, हनले में एक द्रुक्पा मठ उठा, जिसने इस सूनी घाटी को बड़े पवित्र नक्शे में बाँध दिया।

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Hanle monastery newly built, flags snapping in the wind
panels.action: Fresh white walls and dark wooden beams of the young Hanle monastery glow against a deep blue sky, prayer flags snapping sharply as a Hanle rTsis-pa Monk steps into the courtyard carrying a bundle of bound Tibetan manuscripts.

dialogue.text: By the mid-seventeenth century, Hanle’s Drukpa monks kept more than vows and rituals; they guarded rtsis, the exacting art of reckoning days, moons and stars.

i18n.hi: सत्रहवीं सदी के बीच तक, हनले के द्रुक्पा भिक्षु केवल व्रत और पूजा नहीं सँभालते थे; वे र्त्सिस, दिनों, चाँदों और तारों की सख्त गिनती की विद्या की रखवाली करते थे।

panels.shot: intimate interior medium shot over the monk’s shoulder to his desk
panels.action: Inside a dim cell lit by a butter lamp, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk bends over a low table, his fingers hovering above wooden counting pebbles on a marked board, beside a neatly stacked Kalachakra astrology text in Tibetan script.

dialogue.text: Rtsis was no idle fortune game; drawn from Indian Kalachakra and Tibetan scholarship, it was a working lunisolar science, written in ink, stone and memory.

i18n.hi: र्त्सिस कोई खेल-तमाशा नहीं था; भारतीय कालचक्र और तिब्बती विद्या से निकली यह काम करती चंद्रसौर विज्ञान-विद्या थी, जो स्याही, पत्थर और यादों में लिखी जाती थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of the monk in discussion with a farmer and a trader in the courtyard
panels.action: In the sunlit courtyard, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk kneels by a flat stone, setting pebbles as a weathered farmer and a wool-clad trader lean in anxiously, yaks grazing on a distant slope behind them.

dialogue.speaker: hanle_rtsis_pa_monks
dialogue.text: Sow after the fifth day of the bright half; the snows will ease.

i18n.hi: शुक्ल पक्ष की पाँचवीं तिथि के बाद बोओ; बर्फ पीछे हटेगी।

panels.shot: overhead close-up of a rtsis manual, diagrams and numbers visible, monk’s hand pointing
panels.action: An overhead view shows the monk’s calloused finger tracing a dense table of numbers and circular diagrams on a thick manuscript, abacus-like beads resting nearby, while outside the window the thin crescent of the moon hangs over the ridge.

dialogue.text: Tables of mean motions, intercalary months, eclipses: the rtsis-pa’s tools were numbers and cycles, aligning festivals, journeys and fields with a sky that rarely lied.

i18n.hi: औसत गति की सारणियाँ, अधिमास, ग्रहण: र्त्सिस-pa के औज़ार अंक और चक्र थे, जो त्योहार, यात्राएँ और खेतों को उस आकाश से मिला देते थे जो शायद ही कभी झूठ बोलता था।

panels.shot: night-time wide shot, monk on rooftop sighting the moon with simple tools
panels.action: On a flat rooftop under a spray of stars, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk squints along a simple wooden sight fixed to the parapet, checking the height of a bright moon above the black ridgeline, frost rimming his robe’s edge.

dialogue.text: There were no telescopes on this roof; only sightlines, memory and clear air, yet the sky of Hanle served as faithfully as any polished lens.

i18n.hi: इस छत पर दूरबीनें नहीं थीं; बस दृष्टि-रेखाएँ, याद और साफ हवा, पर हनले का आसमान किसी चमकीले लेंस जितना ईमानदार सेवक था।

panels.shot: medium interior shot, monk teaching a younger novice with a chalk board
panels.action: Inside a bare teaching room, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk stands by a soot-blackened board, chalking a circle divided into tithis as a teenage novice follows the arcs with intense concentration, lips silently repeating the sequence.

dialogue.speaker: hanle_rtsis_pa_monks
dialogue.text: Count not just days, child. Count what they bring and what they carry away.

i18n.hi: केवल दिन न गिनो, बच्चा। गिनो, वे क्या लाते हैं और क्या चुपके से ले जाते हैं।

panels.shot: montage-like wide shot showing seasons changing around the monastery
panels.action: The Hanle monastery stands constant as panels of the same view show snow piling against its walls, spring thaw turning the stream to silver and summer sun bleaching the hills, while the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk walks the same path in different robes and ages.

dialogue.text: Decades turned. Empires shifted on distant maps. Yet in Hanle, rtsis-pa monks quietly adjusted their tables, inserting leap months, correcting errors, listening for the sky’s small deviations.

i18n.hi: दशक बीतते गए। दूर के नक्शों पर साम्राज्य हिलते रहे। पर हनले में र्त्सिस-pa भिक्षु चुपचाप सारणियाँ सँवारते रहे, अधिमास जोड़ते, भूलें सुधारते, आकाश की हल्की टेढ़ी चाल सुनते रहे।

panels.shot: somber interior shot during the 19th century, with signs of hardship
panels.action: In a colder, barer hall with cracked plaster and fewer lamps, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk, older now, wraps his robe tighter as he writes by a single flame, while behind him a shelf of manuscripts shows gaps where volumes once stood.

dialogue.text: The nineteenth century brought wars and treaties that thinned Ladakh’s power; monasteries felt the strain, but the need for calendars did not yield to politics.

i18n.hi: उन्नीसवीं सदी में युद्ध और संधियाँ आईं, लद्दाख की शक्ति घटी; मठों पर बोझ पड़ा, पर कैलेंडर की ज़रूरत राजनीति से नहीं झुकी।

panels.shot: medium shot of the monk marking an eclipse date in a ledger, villagers waiting outside
panels.action: The Hanle rTsis-pa Monk dips his pen and carefully marks a future eclipse date on a rough ledger, as silhouettes of villagers wait tensely in the doorway, their faces half-lit by the lamp’s glow.

dialogue.speaker: hanle_rtsis_pa_monks
dialogue.text: On that day, the sun will dim. Do not travel the passes then.

i18n.hi: उस दिन सूर्य फीका होगा। उस समय दर्रों से मत गुजरना।

panels.shot: hard cut to modern era wide shot, Indian Astronomical Observatory domes on the ridge
panels.action: A stark, white modern observatory dome sits on a nearby ridge under the same deep blue sky, solar panels gleaming, a narrow road snaking up the barren slope toward it.

dialogue.text: Then everything changed again. In 2000, another kind of monastery rose on Hanle’s heights: the Indian Astronomical Observatory, steel domes tuned to starlight.

i18n.hi: फिर सब कुछ फिर बदला। 2000 में, हनले की ऊँचाइयों पर एक और तरह का मठ उभरा: भारतीय खगोलीय वेधशाला, इस्पाती गुम्बद जो तारों की रोशनी पर तने हैं।

panels.shot: interior medium shot of a modern telescope inside the dome, engineer adjusting controls
panels.action: Inside the dome, a massive telescope points toward an open hatch of sky, cables and monitors humming softly as a jacketed engineer adjusts a control panel, the glow of screens reflecting spectral lines and graphs.

dialogue.text: The Indian Institute of Astrophysics chose Hanle not for legend but for measurement: dark, dry skies, thin air, steady seeing, almost unmatched in the subcontinent.

i18n.hi: भारतीय खगोल भौतिकी संस्थान ने हनले को कथा नहीं, नाप से चुना: अँधेरे, सूखे आसमान, पतली हवा, स्थिर दृष्टि, जो उपमहाद्वीप में शायद ही कहीं मिलती हो।

panels.shot: poetic composite shot: monk ghostlike in foreground, observatory in background under stars
panels.action: In a night scene where time seems to fold, the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk stands in the foreground on a rocky outcrop, outlined by starlight, while far behind him the modern observatory dome glows faintly, both turned toward the same river of stars.

dialogue.text: The rtsis-pa’s careful lunar months and the telescope’s digital counts lie in different worlds, yet both ask: when will the sky do what, and how can we know?

i18n.hi: र्त्सिस-pa के नपे-तुले चंद्र-मास और दूरबीन की डिजिटल गिनती दो अलग दुनियाओं में हैं, फिर भी दोनों पूछते हैं: आसमान कब क्या करेगा, और हम कैसे जानें?

panels.shot: close-up on monk’s face looking up, stars reflected in his eyes
panels.action: A close view of the Hanle rTsis-pa Monk’s weathered face tilted upward, stars reflected in his dark irises, his breath a faint mist in the frigid air.

dialogue.speaker: hanle_rtsis_pa_monks
dialogue.text: Numbers are bridges, not walls. They only widen what we can see.

i18n.hi: अंक दीवार नहीं, पुल होते हैं। वे बस हमारी नज़र की हद बढ़ाते हैं।

panels.shot: final wide shot of Hanle valley at night, monastery and observatory both visible, Milky Way overhead
panels.action: From a high vantage, the Hanle valley lies in darkness broken only by the soft cluster of monastery lamps and the faint red glow of the observatory dome, while the Milky Way arches in a brilliant band above them.

dialogue.text: On this cold plateau, rtsis manuals and CCD sensors share a horizon; between them runs a simple line of continuity—human beings, counting the sky to place their fragile lives in a larger order.

i18n.hi: इस ठंडे पठार पर, र्त्सिस ग्रंथ और CCD सेंसर एक ही क्षितिज बाँटते हैं; इनके बीच एक सीधी डोरी चलती है—इंसान, जो आसमान गिनते हैं, ताकि नाज़ुक ज़िंदगी को किसी बड़े क्रम में रख सकें।

title_i18n.hi: हनले के भिक्षु गिनते हैं आसमान

subtitle_i18n.en: Under the same cold stars, numbers and light share one sky
subtitle_i18n.hi: उसी ठंडी रात में, अंक और रोशनी एक ही गगन बाँटते हैं
